tables.name: public.content_registry
tables.comment: Canonical KNOuX Store public content registry, seeded from verified repository data.

tables.name: public.contact_requests
tables.comment: Contact submissions. Direct table writes are blocked; use submit_contact_request().

tables.name: public.content_sync_runs
tables.comment: Server-side audit trail for repository-to-database content synchronization.

tables.name: public.signal_alias_submissions
tables.comment: Consent-gated community aliases. Lookup exposes aliases only for verified target profiles that enable them.

tables.name: public.signal_search_events
tables.comment: Only in-product KNOuX Signal lookup/profile-view events. No third-party search visibility is implied.

tables.name: public.signal_viewer_preferences
tables.comment: Viewer disclosure is explicit opt-in. KNOuX Signal never exposes a viewer identity by default.

tables.name: public.signal_source_catalog
tables.comment: KNOuX Signal provenance registry. Live ingestion is restricted to approved sources.

tables.name: public.signal_ingestion_runs
tables.comment: Artifact-level ingestion audit with hashes and import/rejection counts.

tables.name: public.signal_business_phone_records
tables.comment: Public or licensed business phone identities with source-level provenance. Never use for leaked/private contact-book data.

tables.name: public.knoux_bridge_machines
tables.comment: KNOuX Store bridge identities enrolled outbound and measured by heartbeat.

tables.name: public.knoux_bridge_sessions
tables.comment: Short-lived machine sessions. Only SHA-256 token hashes are persisted.

tables.name: public.knoux_bridge_jobs
tables.comment: Durable KNOuX Store cloud-to-local jobs claimed outbound by local bridges.

tables.name: public.knoux_bridge_issuer_meta
tables.comment: Public half of the KNOuX Store bridge ticket issuer. Private material lives only in Supabase Vault.

tables.name: public.knoux_bridge_gateway_principals
tables.comment: Google service-account identities allowed to broker MCP read-only jobs through the KNOuX bridge control plane.

tables.name: public.knoux_bridge_gateway_tokens
tables.comment: Hashed bearer-token registry for the private KNOuX Store MCP Gateway. RLS has no client policies by design.
